title: Design System: Prep50 Neural Signal Lab

display.purpose: Launch promises, completion messages, and score statements.

headline.purpose: The current question and major state messages.

label.purpose: Topics, status, metadata, and compact numeric navigation.

shadows.name: primary-action-lift
shadows.purpose: Low cyan halo beneath the primary action.

shadows.name: primary-action-hover
shadows.purpose: Stronger cyan halo for the raised hover state.

shadows.name: reading-plate
shadows.purpose: Separates a long-form question surface from the night canvas.

shadows.name: feature-stage
shadows.purpose: Grounds the signature neural network stage.

shadows.name: current-record-ring
shadows.purpose: Keeps the current question visible around answered-state fills.

motion.name: control-response
motion.purpose: Primary and secondary button lift, surface, and halo transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dominant next-step action for starting, advancing, submitting, or reviewing.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Begin practice <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 52px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 0 22px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; color: #061020; background: var(--cyan, #35d6ff); font: 780 0.85rem/1.5 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 9px 28px rgba(53,214,255,.2); transition: transform .16s ease, background-color .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #75e5ff; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 13px 34px rgba(53,214,255,.28); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan, #35d6ff) 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary svg { flex: 0 0 auto; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A reversible or lower-priority action such as return, previous, or restart.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M19 12H5m6 6-6-6 6-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg> Previous</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 52px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 0 22px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; color: #eaf0ff; background: var(--panel-2, #111c40); font: 780 0.85rem/1.5 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line, #27355e); transition: background-color .16s ease, transform .16s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #172650; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan, #35d6ff) 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary svg { flex: 0 0 auto; }

components.name: Answer Option
components.description: A large radio-field row for one multiple-choice answer.
components.css: .ds-answer-option { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 66px; padding: 11px 16px 11px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #27355e); border-radius: 13px; color: #dce4f8; background: #0a122c; font: 400 .85rem/1.5 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .14s ease, background-color .14s ease, transform .14s ease; } .ds-answer-option:hover { border-color: #52689d; background: #101b3c; transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-answer-option input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-option-letter { width: 42px; height: 42px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--muted, #9aa9ca); background: #151f42; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 820; } .ds-answer-option:has(input:checked) { border-color: var(--cyan, #35d6ff); background: #0a203b; } .ds-answer-option input:checked + .ds-option-letter { color: #061020; background: var(--cyan, #35d6ff); } .ds-answer-option input:focus-visible + .ds-option-letter { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan, #35d6ff) 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Question Plate
components.description: The dominant flat reading surface for a question and its answer set.
components.html:
Machine LearningRecord 12

Which statement best describes supervised learning?

Choose the strongest answer from the course material.
components.css: .ds-question-plate { max-width: 700px; padding: clamp(26px, 4.6vw, 54px); border-radius: 18px; color: #eef2ff; background: var(--panel, #0d1532); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.24); } .ds-question-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #27355e); color: var(--muted, #9aa9ca); font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 680; } .ds-question-meta span:first-child::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-right: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan, #35d6ff); box-shadow: 0 0 9px var(--cyan, #35d6ff); } .ds-question-plate h2 { max-width: 29ch; margin: clamp(26px, 4vw, 44px) 0 18px; font-size: clamp(1.45rem, 2.6vw, 2.3rem); line-height: 1.28; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-question-plate p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #9aa9ca); font-size: .85rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-question-plate:focus-within { outline: 1px solid var(--cyan, #35d6ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Question Index
components.description: Compact record navigation showing dormant, answered, and current states.
components.html: Question index2/5
components.css: .ds-index { width: 250px; color: #eef2ff; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-index-heading { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; padding-bottom: 14px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--cyan, #35d6ff); font-size: .74rem; } .ds-index-heading strong { color: var(--cyan, #35d6ff); font-size: .68rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-index-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 7px; padding: 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #27355e); } .ds-index-button { aspect-ratio: 1; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line, #27355e); border-radius: 8px; color: #aebadb; background: var(--panel, #0d1532); font: 760 .64rem/1 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-index-button:hover { border-color: var(--cyan, #35d6ff); } .ds-index-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan, #35d6ff) 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-index-button.ds-answered { color: #061020; background: var(--cyan, #35d6ff); border-color: var(--cyan, #35d6ff); } .ds-index-button.ds-current { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--night, #060b1f), 0 0 0 4px var(--pink, #ff5daf); }

components.name: Quiz Header
components.description: A translucent sticky context bar balancing exit, identity, and answered progress.
components.html:
QPrep50
18 of 50 answered
components.css: .ds-quiz-header { min-height: 70px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; padding: 0 24px; color: #eef2ff; background: rgba(6,11,31,.94); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #27355e); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-exit { justify-self: start; border: 0; padding: 8px 0; color: inherit; background: transparent; font-size: .73rem; font-weight: 720; cursor: pointer; } .ds-exit:hover { color: var(--cyan, #35d6ff); } .ds-exit:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan, #35d6ff) 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-quiz-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-size: .8rem; } .ds-quiz-brand span { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 10px; color: #061020; background: var(--cyan, #35d6ff); font-weight: 850; box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(53,214,255,.24); } .ds-answered { justify-self: end; color: var(--muted, #9aa9ca); font-size: .7rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-answered strong { color: var(--cyan, #35d6ff); font-weight: 850; }

components.name: Neural Coverage Signal
components.description: The compact translucent readout embedded in the signature network stage.
components.css: .ds-signal-card { width: min(420px, calc(100% - 32px)); padding: 17px 18px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 5px 18px; border: 1px solid #354775; border-radius: 13px; color: #f5f7ff; background: rgba(8,14,37,.88); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-signal-card span { color: var(--muted, #9aa9ca); font-size: .6rem; } .ds-signal-card strong { font-size: .76rem; } .ds-signal-card i { grid-column: 1 / -1; height: 3px; background: #26345d; overflow: hidden; } .ds-signal-card b { display: block; width: 76%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cyan, #35d6ff), var(--violet, #8466ff), var(--pink, #ff5daf)); transition: width .16s ease; } .ds-signal-card:hover b { width: 82%; } .ds-signal-card:focus-within { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan, #35d6ff) 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Revision Tools
components.description: The coordinated search, course-area filter, and answer-visibility controls for the 300-question revision bank.
components.css: .ds-revision-tools { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, 1fr) minmax(210px, .45fr) auto; gap: 12px; align-items: end; padding: 18px 0; color: #eef2ff; background: var(--night, #060b1f); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #27355e); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-search-field, .ds-select-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--muted, #9aa9ca); font-size: .61rem; } .ds-search-field input, .ds-select-field select { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #27355e); border-radius: 11px; color: #eef2ff; background: var(--panel, #0d1532); font: inherit; outline: 0; } .ds-search-field input::placeholder { color: #7281a4; } .ds-search-field input:focus, .ds-select-field select:focus { border-color: var(--cyan, #35d6ff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(53,214,255,.13); } .ds-answer-toggle { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #43588e; border-radius: 11px; color: var(--cyan, #35d6ff); background: #101b3d; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 780; cursor: pointer; } .ds-answer-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan, #35d6ff) 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-answer-toggle:active { background: #122144; } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-revision-tools { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; padding: 12px 0; } .ds-search-field { grid-column: 1 / -1; } .ds-select-field select, .ds-answer-toggle { min-width: 0; font-size: .65rem; } }

components.name: Difficulty Tags
components.description: Equal-treatment metadata tags for Core, Applied, and Challenge questions.
components.css: .ds-difficulty-tags { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-difficulty-tags span { padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--cyan, #35d6ff); background: #122144; font-size: .58rem; font-weight: 760; }

components.css: .ds-revision-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 24px; padding: 34px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #27355e); color: #eef2ff; background: var(--night, #060b1f); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-revision-number { color: #61709a; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 760; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-revision-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--muted, #9aa9ca); font-size: .65rem; } .ds-revision-meta strong { padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--cyan, #35d6ff); background: #122144; font-size: .58rem; } .ds-revision-item h2 { max-width: 48ch; margin: 12px 0 20px; font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2.3vw, 1.55rem); line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-revision-options { margin: 0; padding-left: 2rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px 28px; color: #bac6e1; font-size: .76rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-revision-options li { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-revision-options .ds-correct-option { color: #071d1a; background: var(--green, #28d8a1); font-weight: 700; } .ds-revision-answer { margin-top: 20px; padding: 16px 18px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 16px; border: 1px solid #255e5d; border-radius: 12px; background: #09282b; } .ds-revision-answer span { color: var(--green, #28d8a1); font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 850; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-revision-answer p { margin: 0; color: #c0ded7; font-size: .75rem; line-height: 1.55; } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-revision-item { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 10px; padding: 28px 0; } .ds-revision-options { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-revision-answer { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 7px; } }

narrative.overview:
Prep50 is a midnight learning instrument: a quiet near-black laboratory where the student's progress appears as a network of live signals. The interface is compact, technical, and legible without becoming clinical; it turns repeated practice into the visible strengthening of connections across eight AI course areas.

The world stays flat and high-contrast wherever sustained reading happens, then spends glow selectively on active signals, focus, and state change. Manrope gives every role one coherent geometric voice, while cyan, violet, and pink separate comprehension, connection, and attention without competing for dominance.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight laboratory surfaces with crisp, cool text.
Violet connections and pink current-record emphasis.
Flat reading plates with restrained, state-driven glow.
Compact geometric typography, tabular numeric data, and route-stable study states.

rules.name: The Semantic Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan means comprehension or available action, violet means connection, pink means current attention, and green or red must not expose correctness during an active attempt; revision may use green only while answers are intentionally shown.

rules.name: The Rarity Makes It Bright Rule
rules.body: Keep luminous color on a minority of each screen so every signal remains meaningful against the laboratory night.

rules.name: The One Instrument Rule
rules.body: Use Manrope for every interface and reading role; hierarchy comes from variable weight, scale, and spacing rather than introducing another family.

rules.name: The Tight-Loud, Open-Quiet Rule
rules.body: Large statements use compressed leading and tracking, while body copy uses relaxed leading for sustained reading.

rules.name: The Reading Before Dashboard Rule
rules.body: Give the current question the flexible column and strongest surface; the index supports navigation but never competes with the reading task.

rules.name: The Uncovered Controls Rule
rules.body: Mobile index and submission controls remain independently reachable in normal document flow, with no fixed overlay covering focus targets.

rules.name: The Route Keeps Its Promise Rule
rules.body: Keep launch, attempt, submission, results, review, and revision at their established URLs; redirect only when protected result content lacks the submitted state required to make it truthful.

rules.name: The Glow Follows State Rule
rules.body: Glow belongs to live nodes, focus, the current record, and primary action—not to every border or container.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Question and explanation surfaces use contrast and thin rules first; reserve elevation for separating an entire reading plate from the surrounding canvas.

rules.name: The Radius Has Rank Rule
rules.body: Small controls stay tighter than reading plates, and reading plates stay tighter than the signature network stage.

dos: Do keep the current question visually dominant and the index subordinate.
Do use semantic signal colors consistently across nodes, progress, focus, and review.
Do keep reading surfaces flat, crisp, and high-contrast.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use tabular figures for scores, counts, progress, and record numbers.
Do keep revision search, topic filtering, answer visibility, and live result count understandable as one coordinated toolset.
donts: Don't use green or red as decorative accents or expose correctness during an active attempt.
Don't put glow on every card, divider, or label; glow must communicate live state.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a soft editorial aesthetic into the lab instrument.
Don't let a sticky or fixed mobile action cover index controls, content, or focus rings.
Don't turn the question surface into a dense dashboard or shrink answer rows below comfortable touch size.
Don't assign separate decorative colors to Core, Applied, and Challenge; correctness colors retain semantic priority.
